Trend checklist confirmed short on both (v -2) and regime BEAR, but the move is already stretched: ETH used 84% of its daily ATR and BTC 117% (exhausted). At the NY open the Nasdaq bounces above its VWAP while ETH and BTC sit at the lows: they diverge lower.
